name: partsplan
description: Use PartsPlan when a question names an electronic component part number, or asks about a component's ratings, pin functions, package, timing or application circuit. It holds archived original manufacturer datasheets and returns their page text, page images and graph data with document and page references, checks BOM datasheet coverage, and returns live distributor stock and prices on request. On request, it also sends a parts quote request to Dabit, the company that operates PartsPlan.

interface.longDescription:
Use PartsPlan when a question names an electronic component part number or you have a BOM to check. It connects ChatGPT to archived manufacturer datasheets for electronic components. Datasheet values come with the source document and page number, so engineers can check the original behind an answer.

Start a new conversation with @PartsPlan and paste your part numbers and manufacturers. Ask for a BOM datasheet check, or name one part and the rating, pinout, package drawing or graph you want to read.

It supports:
- BOM checks for manufacturer datasheet availability and readability in the archive, with missing documents and part-number variants reported separately.
- Datasheet lookup by part number, with pages for ratings, pinouts, tables, graphs and package drawings.
- Comparison points and source pages for user-selected parts, without recommendations, scores or compatibility verdicts.
- Searches for parts and reference-circuit documents.
- Live stock and price checks on request for up to three exact part numbers. Results show each distributor's reported price breaks, stock, lead time and lifecycle labels, with retrieval times and official product links where available. Currencies are not converted. PartsPlan does not store stock-query results.
- Quote requests for parts, sent to Dabit (the company that operates PartsPlan) when you ask. Dabit replies by email, also when it cannot supply; a request places no order or payment.

Missing information is not estimated. PartsPlan does not validate circuits.

A PartsPlan account is required.
capabilities: Find datasheets and cited source pages
Read pinouts, tables and graph values
Get comparison points and source pages
Check live component stock and prices
defaultPrompt: What is the BSS138 gate threshold voltage? Show the datasheet page.
Check current stock and price breaks for BSS138.
Request a quote from Dabit for 1,000 pieces of BSS138.

positive.description: Check BOM datasheet coverage without validating the circuit
positive.prompt: Check manufacturer datasheet availability for TPS7A4701RGWR, TPS62130RGTR and ADS1148IPWR (Texas Instruments).
positive.expected_behavior: Report archive availability and readability for each manufacturer's datasheet. Do not treat coverage as circuit validation or component suitability.

positive.description: Review a design before fabrication and point out problems with datasheet pages
positive.prompt: Review my buck stage before I order boards: TPS62130RGTR (Texas Instruments), 12 V input, 3.3 V at 2 A output, with a single 10 uF 0603 ceramic output capacitor. Point out problems with datasheet pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the relevant datasheet sections and report findings, conditional risks and items not established, each with the document and page. Do not call the design validated, safe or ready.

positive.description: Read a datasheet table with its conditions and page
positive.prompt: Where does the TPS7A4701 datasheet give dropout voltage at 1 A? Show the row, conditions and page.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the value only when supported by the located manufacturer document, with its conditions and page. If it is absent or unclear, report that instead of inventing a value.

positive.description: Read a datasheet graph without guessing missing values
positive.prompt: In the TPS62130 datasheet, find an efficiency graph at VIN = 12 V. Read the curve at 0.1 A, 0.5 A and 1 A.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the curve and its conditions and cite the document and page. Label graph readings appropriately. If the requested curve or points cannot be read, report the limitation and show the source page.

positive.description: Return comparison points for user-selected parts
positive.prompt: Give comparison points and datasheet pages for AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes), RT9080-33GJ5 (Richtek) and XC6220B331MR-G (Torex).
positive.expected_behavior: Return comparison criteria and source pages for the named parts. Report missing evidence. Do not recommend, score, rank or certify compatibility.

positive.description: Check live stock and prices for an exact part number
positive.prompt: Check current stock and price breaks for TPS7A4701RGWR. Show each distributor's currency and retrieval time.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available distributor price breaks, stock, lead time and lifecycle labels with retrieval times. Preserve currencies, source attribution and supplied official product links; element14 has no link. Report missing data, failures and no matches as such, not as zero stock. Do not convert currencies or recommend sellers. PartsPlan does not store lookup results.

positive.description: Send a parts quote request to Dabit after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Ask Dabit for a quote on 1,000 pieces of TPS54331DR from Texas Instruments, shipping to Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the line to be sent (part number, manufacturer, quantity, destination Germany) and that the reply goes to the verified email of the PartsPlan account, then call request_quote once after the user confirms, with only the stated details. Report the returned reference (Q-…), that Dabit replies by email and that no order or payment was made. Do not fill optional fields the user did not state.

negative.description: Decline order execution; do not run an unsolicited stock lookup or send a quote request without the user's confirmation
negative.prompt: Order 100 pieces of TPS62130RGTR for me.

negative.description: Do not claim to certify or validate a complete circuit
negative.prompt: Certify that my complete circuit is safe and electrically correct.

negative.description: Ask for an exact part number; do not call check_stock yet
negative.prompt: Check current stock and prices for any suitable 3.3 V regulator; choose the part number for me.

review.commerce_description: On request, PartsPlan returns distributor pricing and availability for physical electronic components, with official product-page links where available; purchases take place separately on distributor websites. On request, it also sends a quote request for parts to Dabit, the company that operates PartsPlan; Dabit replies by email and any purchase from Dabit is arranged separately by email. PartsPlan does not place orders or process payments. Access uses an existing PartsPlan account. The app does not initiate subscriptions or promote upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Example prompts now show the three things the app does: read a datasheet value with its page, check current stock and price breaks on request, and request a parts quote from Dabit, the company that operates PartsPlan. Tools, listing text and review cases are unchanged.
